entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Ajuran Empire, a political institution in Somalia during Medieval Somali Sultanates (1300–1700). Grew from Ifat and Adal Sultanates and Sultanate of Mogadishu. Led to the emergence of Ajuran Sultanate/Empire.
